person.headline: One line: role and main stack. Max 80 characters. No adjectives.
person.summary: 2 or 3 sentences: who they are, what they work on and what makes them different. It is the first thing a recruiter reads.
person.contactMessage: 1 to 3 short sentences: availability, preferred work mode and how to get in touch.
projects[].summary: One sentence: what the project is. Shown on the featured card.
projects[].problem: One sentence: the situation before, and why it mattered.
projects[].solution: 2 to 4 sentences: how it was built, with the key technical decisions.
projects[].learnings[]: One sentence: a concrete lesson, not a generic one.
projects[].areaNotes.{area}: One sentence: what this project proves in {area}. Do not repeat the project summary.
experience[].highlights[]: One CV bullet: past-tense action verb, how (technology), result. Max 30 words. ATS friendly.
evidence[].title: A short title for the evidence: what happened, in a few words. No adjectives.
evidence[].context: Context: the situation before the author acted. Only facts from the data.
evidence[].action: Action: what the author did, in first person. Only facts from the data.
evidence[].result: Result: what changed; only facts from the data.
labs[].description: 2 or 3 sentences: what this group of experiments explores and why it matters for the author's work.
